project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Continuous Stage SPI
project.description: Engine-agnostic boundary for running one StreamingStageSpec continuously - mirrors fowf's own ExecutionEngineProvider seam shape (identity + a start/observe boundary), adapted for a stage that runs forever once started rather than a command that reaches a terminal state. See this repo's own continuous-streaming gap-bridging plan (docs/ or the session's plan file). Kept as its own module, separate from any one implementation, so a future Pekko provider can implement this SPI without depending on the Kafka Streams provider module.
